governance_sections.A: Display Rule (Mandatory step number, PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIED/STOP distinction, executed/unexecuted operations)
governance_sections.B: Button Rule (Function-matched buttons, explicit approval for new approvals, no execution-guarantee claim)
governance_sections.C: Pre-STOP and Pre-Instruction Chat Verification Gate (Mandatory check of current and available past chat history)
governance_sections.D: Per-Response Verification Record (4-point summary: past history match, deduplication, feasibility, display/button/STOP)
governance_sections.B_ADD: Button Operation Explanation Pairing (Explicit pairing of button action, user next step, and unexecuted scope)
governance_sections.E: Actual Violation Record (Mandatory logging of fail occurrences and causes without claiming automatic compliance)
governance_sections.F: Mandatory Per-Response Checklist (6-item pre-flight and pre-send verification)
governance_sections.G: Governance Re-Verification and Applied Record (Verification of actual document contents against past records)
governance_sections.H: Shortest Remaining Work and Progress Condition Registration (Local governance recording of remaining steps)
governance_sections.I: Mandatory Progress Rule Freeze (Fixation of top-priority operational rules without false PASS assertions)
governance_sections.J: Button Mode Update ('進める', '承認して進める', 'コピー' differentiation)
governance_sections.K: Limitation of Button Omission Conditions (Button omission permitted only when zero safe and executable path exists)
governance_sections.L: Attachment File Operational Rule (Verification of existing attachments before requesting re-attachments)
governance_sections.M: Chat History Scope Clarification (Broad scope covering current chat, accessible past chats, work records, attachments)
